explanation: Always 0 at D1, and 8-10 at GO: about 10 after an unrewarded trial or when choosing a2, about 8 after a rewarded trial while choosing a1 (sometimes 6-7 late in the episode). At D2 it tracks recent success. It is 10 during a run of rewarded trials choosing a1 (even if this trial is transition is rare), drops to about 7-8 after one unreward or when choosing a2 with rewards, and falls to about 3-5 after several unrewarded trials in a row, especially on a2 choices with rare transitions.
